questions.q: How many fundamental rights are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explain: There are6 fundamental rights originally7, but right to property was removed by 44th Amendment.

questions.q: Who is the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explain: The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.q: Which Article deals with the Right to Equality?
questions.explain: Article 14 deals with Equality before law and equal protection of laws.

questions.q: How many members can the Lok Sabha have?
questions.explain: Maximum strength of Lok Sabha is552 (543 elected + 2 nominated Anglo-Indian + 7 nominated).

questions.q: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
questions.explain: The President of India appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.q: Which schedule of the Indian Constitution lists the languages?
questions.explain: The Eighth Schedule lists the22 recognized languages of India.

questions.q: What is the minimum age to become President of India?
questions.explain: Minimum age to become President of India is35 years.

questions.q: Which Article is known as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
questions.explain: Dr. Ambedkar called Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) the heart and soul.

questions.q: How many members are in the Constituent Assembly?
questions.explain: The Constituent Assembly had299 members.

questions.q: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explain: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution.

questions.q: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explain: Part IVA (Article 51A) deals with Fundamental Duties, added by 42nd Amendment.

questions.q: What is the tenure of the President of India?
questions.explain: The President of India serves a term of5 years.

questions.q: How many subjects are there in the Union List?
questions.explain: The Union List has97 subjects (originally97, now updated).

questions.q: Which Constitutional Amendment is known as the 'Mini Constitution'?
questions.explain: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the Mini Constitution for its sweeping changes.

questions.q: Who presides over the joint sitting of Parliament?
questions.explain: The Speaker of Lok Sabha presides over joint sitting of Parliament.

questions.q: Which Article provides for National Emergency?
questions.explain: Article 352 provides for National Emergency (armed rebellion, war, external aggression).

questions.q: What is the quorum for a sitting of Lok Sabha?
questions.explain: Quorum for Lok Sabha is1/10th of total membership (minimum 55 members).

questions.q: Which Amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18?
questions.explain: The 61st Amendment (1988) lowered voting age from 21 to 18 years.

questions.q: Who has the power to declare a National Emergency?
questions.explain: The President of India declares National Emergency on Cabinet's written advice.

questions.q: How many Fundamental Duties are there currently?
questions.explain: There are11 Fundamental Duties (10 original + 1 added by 86th Amendment in 2002).
